evidence: The 12-byte records are the DriverProfileIdentifier at +0x10 of each .pps file (Profile_ReadFileHeaderDate copies it; FrontendProfile_IsAlreadyInChampionship compares name and flags with the profiles).
Fastest time on the stage so far: replaced when a finishing time beats it, together with the leader's name (RallyData_SetFinishLineResultMessages); cleared with the name.
Per car, set when the car's time becomes the stage leader time; RallyData draws text 0x83 while set.
The profile's best time on this stage, read from CategoryBestResults (rallyStageTimes / arcadeStageTimes .time); a finish below it sets g_finishStageRecordMessage.
Screen height the split bars were laid out for (with g_stageLeader.splitBarResX); a change relays them out.
CGameInfo::IsSplitBarEnabled() when the split bars were laid out; a change relays them out.
Per car, set when the finishing time beats g_profileBestStageTime; RallyData draws text 0x6a while set. A view at +0x8c of the split block.
StageLeaderBlock: leader name (sprintf of the leader's record name), last split passed, split bar width.
